name: Lost Colors
source:
This is a world without colors - the world of lost colors.
The main character is an executioner specializing in eliminating those infected by resurgences of color -- the so-called Colors. However, one day he becomes such being himself - and thus the hunter becomes the hunted. He needs to travel the colored world to uncover the mystery behind world creation and revert the disease of colors that he contracted.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
